_doc: Schema contract v2. Simplified free-form output with client research.

aiRequest._note: The app builds this object from formData + deterministic results.

client.name: string
client.regionPack: string — NA | EUI | LATAM | APAC | Global

phase1_research.purpose: Gather real-time info about the client/brand
phase1_research.output: Free text summary of brand, products, audience, competitors, recent activity

aiResponse._note: Each value is a markdown-formatted string. The app renders it as HTML.
aiResponse.pitch: string — Full sales pitch narrative with markdown formatting
aiResponse.funnel: string — Full-funnel strategy narrative with budget allocation rationale
aiResponse.mediaPlan: string — Ad format recommendations and campaign phasing
aiResponse.bestPractices: string — Tailored tips, vertical advice, mistakes to avoid
aiResponse.creative: string — Creative strategy, content pillars, format recommendations

tabOwnership.pitch: AI — full narrative, grounded in client research
tabOwnership.funnel: AI — strategy with deterministic budget splits referenced
tabOwnership.mediaPlan: AI — format rationale with deterministic formats referenced
tabOwnership.creative: AI — creative strategy and content pillars
